purpose: Deterministic bootstrap metadata for every evidence image, preparing the corpus for VLM evaluation (Vision Evidence Retrieval v0.2).

boundaries.deterministic_fields: extracted by bootstrap_metadata.py from the file itself, its path, filename conventions, and durable metadata joins (OBS evidence_references, review manifests).
boundaries.vlm_pending_fields: left null by this pipeline; to be filled by a later VLM pass with vlm_status promoted from PENDING.
boundaries.forbidden_fields: never generated by this pipeline: authority_type, failure_category, planner_decision, execution_permission. These are process/authorization metadata and must be attached only from durable records at ingest; they are not pixel-derivable.

record_id.description: sha256 hex of the image file; stable identity

source_path.description: repository-relative path of the original image; never modified by this pipeline

sha256.description: sha256 hex of the image file bytes

run_id.description: durable run identity or null when not derivable

session_hint.description: session id fragment embedded in recovered-frame filenames; NOT a run_id

captured_at.description: capture timestamp only when provable; null otherwise

file_mtime_utc.description: filesystem mtime; weak signal, never a capture claim

vlm.description: VLM-pending block; null values until the VLM pass runs

run_id: basename found in review_batches/<batch>/review_manifest.jsonl (original_copy or annotated_copy) -> REVIEW_MANIFEST_JOIN (entry.source_run)
sha256 found in an OBS artifact evidence_references/screenshot binding -> OBS_EVIDENCE_JOIN (artifact run_id)
captured_at: sha256 join against OBS artifacts -> OBS_EVIDENCE_JOIN (exact capture time)
otherwise null + NOT_DERIVABLE; file_mtime_utc is recorded separately and is never a capture claim

outputs.records: enza_memory/evidence_metadata/metadata_records.jsonl (one record per image, sorted by source_path, deterministic)

guarantees: original images are opened read-only and never modified
records are deterministic: same corpus -> byte-identical records file except report generated_at
